entries.condition: the publish answer, the context cell, the judge's question and the flow-voice fact of a sandbox address row none of whose flows the rule placed in the sample's process tree, where the rule read no flow row to it and its reading records that a conversation of the job's capture is with it; beside each of the forms of a reading of no flow row
basis: the row's flow_reading: processes, unnamed and capture_conversation (set by the network block from the capture's conversations that are not inbound only)

entries.condition: the publish answer and context cell of a sandbox address row the publish rule puts on a lineage whose list is set only where every flow to it is of that kind (outside the sample's process tree, a process the report does not list, a script host naming the launcher) that holds no reading of its flow rows: a row of a report stored before the reading was recorded, on the surfaces served or packaged from that stored report (the report and its HTML, the IOC list, the evidence bundle, the job package) with no job entry that agrees with its stored decision; on the build path every address row carries its reading, so the form reaches no judge fact, flow-voice fact or capture line
basis: the stored row's outside_processes, unlisted_processes and launcher_unsettled_processes
the stored row's sample_process_tree

entries.condition: the publish answer and context cell of a sandbox address row with a disputed lineage (a list set wherever any flow to it is disputed) that holds no reading of its flow rows: a row of a report stored before the reading was recorded, on the surfaces served or packaged from that stored report (the report and its HTML, the IOC list, the evidence bundle, the job package) with no job entry that agrees with its stored decision; it names the disputed processes and claims nothing of the other flows to it; on the build path every address row carries its reading, so the form reaches no judge fact, flow-voice fact or capture line
basis: the stored row's marked_only_processes, file_only_processes and marked_by

entries.condition: in the publish answer and the words beside it of a sandbox address row none of whose flows the rule placed in the sample's process tree, whose flow rows name no process id and were read in more than one part view of one detonation and in no whole one
basis: the row's flow_reading: unnamed and unnamed_counted

entries.condition: the publish answer, the context cell, the judge's question and the flow-voice fact of a sandbox address row none of whose flows the rule placed in the sample's process tree, where the rule read no flow row to it: after the clause naming the views it read as a part, or alone on a reading recorded before the views it read were (a row of a report stored before them, on the surfaces served from it)
basis: the row's flow_reading: processes, unnamed, part_views and views_read

entries.condition: the publish answer, the context cell, the judge's question and the flow-voice fact of a sandbox address row none of whose flows the rule placed in the sample's process tree, where the rule read no flow row to it and its reading records that it read no network view of the sandbox
basis: the row's flow_reading: processes, unnamed and views_read 0

entries.condition: in the publish answer and the words beside it of a sandbox address row whose sentence names processes first, where its other flow rows name no process id and were read in more than one part view of one detonation and in no whole one
basis: the row's flow_reading: processes, unnamed and unnamed_counted

entries.condition: in the publish answer and the words beside it of a sandbox address row where the flow rows of a process it names were read in more than one part view of one detonation and in no whole one, in place of a count of flows
basis: the row's flow_reading: each process's flows and counted

entries.condition: the publish answer, the context cell, the judge's question and the flow-voice fact of a sandbox address row none of whose flows the rule placed in the sample's process tree, where the rule read no flow row to it, read no view as a part, and its reading records that it read the network view of one detonation (view) or of several (views)
basis: the row's flow_reading: processes, unnamed, part_views and views_read

entries.condition: the first refusing part of the publish answer of a row an analyst's listing gave (source analyst), of any kind, followed by whose listing it is where the row names an analyst, on every surface that prints or reads the answer (the indicator table, a cell beside a value, the mark of an unpublished value, the writers' table answers and their retry feedback, the export's decline, the job package)
basis: the row's source (analyst)
the listing's analyst, as the table's listed path names it (listed_by)

entries.condition: in the first refusing part of the publish answer of a row an analyst's listing gave, after whose listing it is: the test that refuses such a row (the publish rule's evidence reason gives a listing no source)
basis: the row's source (analyst), which the evidence reason refuses as a source for every kind

entries.condition: the fact after the refusal of a listed value or a judge's value, where the whole-value search of the run's ledger was run for it (the report's tool_sightings): what the search read
basis: the report's tool_sightings (ledger_projection.tool_sightings: the kept text of every entry with ok set)

entries.condition: the fact after the refusal of a listed value or a judge's value on a report stored before the whole-value search of the ledger was run (no tool_sightings): what the search of the kept tool sections read
basis: the stored report's sections whose source is a tool, searched whole-value

entries.condition: the fact after the refusal of a listed value, and of a value of another source or a judge's value that the search found: what the whole-value search read (and, for the run's ledger, that it sets apart an answer to a query for the value), then the entries it found the value in, or none, or none and the answers to a query for it it set apart, named
basis: the report's tool_sightings and tool_queries for the value's key, or the stored report's kept tool sections

entries.condition: in the refusing part of the answer for a value the judge's indicator names that no row holds and the whole-value search found in a tool answer: what names it, in place of a row
basis: the judge's indicators (judge_value_answer: no static string row holds the value)

entries.condition: the first half of the strings refusal of a judge's value with no row of its own that the whole-value search found in a tool answer, where no row of the string sweep holds it
basis: the run's second-source record (SecondSources.swept) holds no row for the value
the judge's indicators

entries.condition: the first half of the refusing part of a value asked as the string sweep's that nothing admitted: the rows that hold it by tool and entry, a row with no entry by its source, or a value no row holds by its row's source or, for a judge's value with no row, by the judge's indicator
basis: the run's second-source record (SecondSources.swept)
the row's source
the judge's indicators

entries.condition: the refusing part of a value asked as the string sweep's that nothing admitted, a row the whole-value search found the value in among them: where it is from (strings_source), then what the deciding test found (a recovery and a reputation record for a network value, the second-source lookup for any other)
basis: the run's second-source record
the row's reputation record and recovery

entries.condition: every row's publish answer and every judge value's, on every surface that prints or reads it: yes with the evidence reason, or no with each refusing test as its own part and the facts after them; a listed value's answer gives the listing's test, the judge's keep for a network value, and what the whole-value search found as a fact; a row of another source the search found is refused by its own tests with the search's entries and who lists it as facts
basis: the row's kind, value, source and reputation
the run's second-source record, recovery and verdict
the sandbox's facts, the judge's keep and who lists or mentions the value
the report's tool_sightings and tool_queries

entries.condition: in the fact after the refusal of a listed value or a judge's value where the whole-value search of the run's ledger was run for it, right after what the search read: that the search sets apart an answer to a query for the value
basis: ledger_projection.tool_sightings: an entry whose call arguments hold the value is kept apart, in tool_queries
